title: RAP Flipped Classroom
text:
This is the website for the Reproducible Analytical Pipelines (RAP) Flipped Classroom workshops, running from October-December 2026. These workshops are funded by the Strategic Commissioning Intelligence Centre (SCIC).
Information about this project will be hosted here.
